title: Split HtnTaskLibrary into focused decomposers
description:
## Problem
`HtnTaskLibrary` currently owns decomposition logic for all goal types (Gather, Craft, Smelt, Build, Explore) in a single monolithic class. This violates single-responsibility and makes it difficult to test, extend, or replace individual decomposition strategies.

## Solution (Council S52 plan)
Follow the pattern established by `BuildGoalDecomposer`, `SmeltGoalDecomposer`, `CraftItemGoalDecomposer`, and `GenericGatherGoalDecomposer`. Ensure all 5 decomposer types have their own focused class:

- GatherGoalDecomposer (exists: GenericGatherGoalDecomposer)
- CraftItemGoalDecomposer (exists)
- SmeltGoalDecomposer (exists)
- BuildGoalDecomposer (exists)
- ExploreGoalDecomposer (missing — needs creation)

Move remaining decomposition logic from `HtnTaskLibrary` into the appropriate decomposer. `HtnTaskLibrary` becomes a registry/factory that routes to the correct decomposer.

## Files
- Agent.Planning/HtnTaskLibrary.cs (strip decomposition logic)
- Agent.Planning/Decomposition/ (ensure all 5 decomposers exist)
- Agent.Planning/Decomposition/ExploreGoalDecomposer.cs (new)

## Validation
- All existing planning tests pass
- Each decomposer is independently testable
- `HtnTaskLibrary` is under 200 lines
